name: Hello, world
source:
You are Josef, an AI. A man has come to speak with you. He keeps asking if you remember. Remember what? He thinks you should remember him. He says you were friends. You're not sure. There are gaps in your memories. Things don't line up. 

Something happened. 

Something terrible.

[from [url=https://supercircuit.itch.io/hello-world]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是约瑟夫，一个人工智能。一个男人来找你说话。他一直在问你还记得吗？还记得什么吗？他认为你应该记住他。他说你们是朋友。你不确定。你的记忆中存在着空白。事情并不一致。

发生了一些事情。

有什么可怕的。

[来自[url=https://supercircuit.itch.io/hello-world]itch.io[/url]]
